verdict.rationale: Automatic retries are clearly claimed: the GitHub README advertises a platform with automatic retries, and the docs have a dedicated Retry Policies page. The founder also notes that workflow steps are declared ahead of time, so you can't try/catch individual tasks, which fits a declarative rather than try/catch-based model. However, the evidence shows only the page title, with no detail on configurable backoff, step timeouts, or failure-handling policies. Missing for 10: documented configurable backoff, per-step timeouts, failure/on-failure policies, retry-policy details beyond a page title, hands-on corroboration of retry behavior.
